integration.consumer: Yielded output passed pure preflight only. Parent must complete real operation/callback before resume, supply typed reply only when explicit expects*Reply flag true.
integration.native_result: Finished.nativeResult is complete native HandleTriggerDown result. Partial Charge reports false and preserves original request; no shot is claimed.
composition: incomplete charge or FireOnRelease: actual ShowAimLine source guard; nonempty UI path explicit unsupported
FireGraphic then common Weapon.Fire then actual GUN fire
inline FireFx/FireFx2 even when virtual Fire bool false
integration.release: WeaponTriggerRelease covers FireOnRelease=false with real SwapOnRelease, optional ChargeCancelGraphic/cancelChargeOnUnit, zero-duration status branch, original OnWeaponTriggerRelease. Other paths fail explicitly.

input.observed: PlayerUnitInput.CheckWeaponInput qualifies new requests from primary/alternate control bit2, secondary required bit2, disallowed excluded bit2. FullyAutomatic=false and not Charging additionally requires primary/alternate bit4. CanPullTriggerWithoutMoving=false requires owner+3ba flag or nonzero LeftStickLocation. Animation DisableOwnerWeapons or failed status CanAttack uses actual ShouldLocKTrigger fallback.
input.request_retention: Weapon.Update retains current request through partial charge. It clears after fired/failed-cooldown-animation/FireOnRelease finalization. Finger-up does not justify unconditional clearFireRequest.
input.unknown: No semantic Down/Pressed enum attribution claimed from bit masks alone. Full PlayerUnitInput target/autolock/alternate arbitration remains a separate consumer. Direct LockTrigger/LockTriggerForCharge/LockTriggerForClip native read semantics not established from source field names.

ShouldLocKTrigger.weapon_gate: AcceptTriggerLockRequests true and not (IgnoreTriggerLockDuringCooldown and cooldownRemaining>0)
ShouldLocKTrigger.effect_scan: pending then active; for every DisableAttack, require RequestTriggerLock(full+1ae); any false returnsfalse; at least one requester returns true. Cancelable is a different adjacent field full+1ad.
ShouldLocKTrigger.excluded: No status timer, Cleared/Disposed, SelfApplied, immunity or Cancelable test in this native routine

extra_args.IsPerfectCharge: insert true only if chargeDuration>0 and (lockedPerfectCharge or perfectChargeWindowRemaining>0); otherwise absent; not WasLastFirePerfectCharge
extra_args.ProjectileName: only if valid primary projectile, from current per-instance ProjectileData.Name
extra_args.OwnerTable: actual attached owner Lua table, otherwise nil
extra_args.Ammo: GetAmmo; recursively follows present ShareAmmoWeapon, otherwise local ammo
extra_args.TargetX/TargetY: only if optional target captured before PostFire clearing is present

OnWeaponFired.filter: weapon name; ScriptPlayerIndex>0 compares actual owner player index+1 only when both owner/player pointers exist

Z.owner_z: Thing.GetZLocation (parent recursively + localZOffset if valid parent, else mZLocation). Projectile.Init owner inheritance uses this value only.
Z.totalZ: Thing.GetZLocation + Unit.GetAirborneZ; not unconditional Animation.GetZLocation. Airborne contribution requires actual selected slide Airborne and current AnimationData.Z.
